user.title: Connect your legacy stove
user.description: Enter the local address and four-digit APP PIN. Setup only reads status: this protocol cannot safely verify the PIN without a control command. An incorrect PIN is reported when the stove rejects a command. No setting is changed during setup.

data_description.host: Local hostname or IP, without http:// or a port.
data_description.pin: Four digits from the stove display, including leading zeros.

reconfigure.title: Update connection
reconfigure.description: Enter the new address and APP PIN. The device serial must match. Setup reads status only; the PIN is checked on the next control command.

reauth_confirm.title: Update APP PIN
reauth_confirm.description: The stove rejected a command. Check the PIN on the stove display. This read-only connection test cannot validate it; the next command will use the new PIN.

error.invalid_auth: The stove rejected authentication. Check the APP PIN.
error.invalid_input: Enter a valid local host and a four-digit APP PIN.
error.timeout: The stove did not respond in time.
error.unsupported_device: No supported legacy KS01 controller was found.
error.unknown: The stove returned an unexpected response.

abort.wrong_device: The device serial does not match the configured stove.

invalid_auth.message: The stove rejected the APP PIN. Update it in the integration settings.

cannot_connect.message: Cannot obtain a valid stove status. Connection recovery will be retried automatically.

command_failed.message: The command could not be confirmed. It may have executed. Check the stove state before retrying.

invalid_value.message: This value is not supported by the stove.
